body: A web interface for generating subtitles with Whisper.
plain_description: **Turn audio and video into subtitles and translated text with a browser-based tool.** Generate subtitles from files, YouTube, or a microphone, then translate subtitle files or add speaker labels.
technical_description: A Gradio browser interface for Whisper transcription, using faster-whisper by default, with options for openai/whisper and insanely-fast-whisper. It supports SRT, WebVTT, and plain text output; speech-to-text translation into English; subtitle translation with NLLB or DeepL; and optional Silero VAD, UVR background music separation, and pyannote speaker diarization. The README also describes Docker and local installation, plus a separate REST API in the backend.
title: Whisper-WebUI
